title: Cursed Text
description: My first Texture pack! It changes the English lang text into the cursed formatted text from Minecraft. It also will change some other things via background panaorama, menu music, and music discs
body:
My first Project! It changes the English lang text into the cursed formatted text from Minecraft.

What it changes:
- The english language text
- minecraft title + subtitle word art

Bonus Changes:
- menu background music 
- The pigstep music disc
- UI click sound
